posts.description: Send a water sample from any city in Pakistan to a PNAC accredited lab in Karachi or Lahore: holding times, bottles, courier and field sampling.
posts.excerpt: Which parameters travel by courier, which need a field visit, and how to dispatch a sample from any city in Pakistan to Envi Tech AL's laboratories in Karachi and Lahore.
posts.author: hina
posts.image_alt: Water testing lab in Pakistan: how to get a sample tested from any city, Envi Tech AL Karachi and Lahore
faqs: Is there a water testing lab near me if I am outside Karachi and Lahore?

Envi Tech AL's laboratories are in Karachi and Lahore. From any other city in Pakistan you can send chemistry samples by overnight courier after a call to confirm bottles and parameters, or book a field visit for microbiology and regulatory sampling.
Which city's laboratory should I send my sample to?

Whichever your courier reaches faster. As a rule, Sindh and Balochistan send to Karachi; Punjab, Islamabad, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Azad Kashmir send to Lahore. Both laboratories issue the same report format.
Can bacteriological water testing be done by courier?

Only when the sample reaches the laboratory within 24 hours of sampling, in a sterile bottle, cooled with ice packs. A same-day or overnight courier from a nearby city works. From a distant city, a field visit is the reliable option.
Can I use a mineral water bottle for the sample?

For TDS, hardness, chloride and similar general chemistry, a rinsed mineral water bottle is acceptable. For microbiology or metals it is not; those need a sterile bottle and an acid-preserved bottle respectively, which the laboratory supplies.
How much water is needed?

One litre covers a standard drinking water chemistry panel. Microbiology needs a separate 250 mL sterile bottle. Metals need a separate 250 mL preserved bottle. For a full PEQS panel plan on about two litres in three bottles.
How long does a result take once the sample arrives?
It depends on the parameter list. Microbiology needs incubation time, and some metals are run in batches. The laboratory gives a reporting date at booking, which is the date to plan around.
Will the report be accepted by Sindh EPA or Punjab EPA?

Envi Tech AL's Karachi laboratory is Sindh EPA certified and the Lahore laboratory is listed by Punjab EPA. Reports state the method, the standard applied and the accreditation number for each parameter, which is what the agencies review. Whether a submission is approved depends on the results and the rest of the file, not on the laboratory.
How do I check the report is genuine?
Every report carries verification details that can be checked on the report verification portal at envitechal.com using the report number and date.

posts.description: Check a lab's PNAC accreditation in three steps: LAB number in the PNAC directory, the scope document and the current certificate. Signs of a false claim.
posts.excerpt: What a PNAC LAB number and scope actually cover, how to verify them in minutes, and the signs that an accreditation claim is marketing, lapsed, or borrowed.
posts.author: imran
posts.image_alt: How to verify a PNAC accredited testing laboratory in Pakistan: certificate number, scope and validity
faqs: How do I check whether a laboratory in Pakistan is PNAC accredited?

Search the directory of accredited laboratories on pnac.gov.pk for the laboratory name or certificate number, confirm the address matches, open the scope document and check the parameter you need, then ask the laboratory for its current certificate to confirm the validity date.
What is the difference between ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation and ISO 9001 certification?

ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation is an assessment of a laboratory's technical competence for specific tests, granted by an accreditation body such as PNAC. ISO 9001 certification is an audit of a management system by a certification body. A laboratory can hold both; only the first speaks to the reliability of a test result.
Does PNAC accreditation cover all tests a laboratory offers?

No. It covers the matrices, parameters and methods listed in the laboratory's scope document, at the accredited site. Tests outside the scope can still be performed and reported, but they are not accredited results.
What are Envi Tech AL's PNAC accreditation numbers?
LAB-285 for the Karachi laboratory in Bahadurabad and LAB-347 for the Lahore laboratory in Johar Town. Each applies only to that site and its published scope.
The PNAC website shows an older expiry date for a laboratory. Has it lapsed?

Not necessarily. Listings are updated periodically and can lag a renewal. Ask the laboratory for the current certificate showing the reassessment and validity dates, and compare the certificate number with the directory.
Does Sindh EPA or Punjab EPA require PNAC accreditation?

Both agencies maintain their own lists of certified or approved environmental laboratories, and PNAC accreditation is a central part of qualifying for them. For a regulatory submission, check that the laboratory appears on the relevant agency's list as well as in the PNAC directory.
Can a laboratory's accreditation be used by its branch in another city?
No. Accreditation is site-specific. A second site needs its own assessment and certificate, which is why Envi Tech AL holds separate numbers for Karachi and Lahore.

posts.excerpt: Borewell water is a salinity problem, tanker water a bacteriology problem, RO water a verification problem. The tests that matter for each Karachi source, and the limits they are read against.
posts.author: hina
posts.image_alt: Water testing in Karachi: borewell, tanker and RO water explained, with PEQS and WHO limits
faqs: Which water testing lab in Karachi tests borewell water?

Envi Tech AL's PNAC accredited laboratory (LAB-285) in Bahadurabad tests borewell, tanker, RO and piped water, with results compared against PEQS and WHO limits. Samples can be dropped off or collected by the field team.
What should I test tanker water for?

Total coliform and E. coli on each new supplier, plus TDS as a check on the fill source. For businesses receiving regular deliveries, a monthly sample from the receiving tank and residual chlorine after dosing.
What TDS should RO water have?

Well below the PEQS limit of 1,000 mg/L and a small fraction of the feed water; 100 to 300 mg/L is typical for a healthy plant on Karachi borewell feed. Below about 50 mg/L the water is flat and mildly corrosive, which is why some plants remineralise.
Is high TDS in Karachi water dangerous?

TDS itself is a palatability and scaling issue rather than a health hazard at the levels seen in Karachi. The health questions in the same water are nitrate, arsenic and bacteria, which TDS does not reveal and which must be tested separately.
How often should a household test its water?

A borewell once a year and after any change in taste; tanker water on each new supplier; an RO plant every three months and after servicing; piped water in the tank after each tank cleaning. Businesses under Sindh EPA or audit requirements follow the frequency in their monitoring plan.
Can I bring the sample myself?

Yes. The laboratory is at 345, First Floor, Street 15, Block 3, Bahadurabad, Karachi, open Monday to Saturday, 09:00 to 17:00. Call first so the right bottles are ready and the sample is booked in on arrival. For regulatory or audit reports, ask for field sampling so the sampling record is part of the report.
Is the report accepted by Sindh EPA?

The Karachi laboratory is Sindh EPA certified and PNAC accredited, and reports state the method, limit and accreditation status for each parameter. Acceptance of a submission depends on the results and the rest of the file; the report provides the evidence in the form the agency reviews.
